cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We wanted a home we could call ours. Start the cottage survey with the roof, please; don't just circle every leak.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then measure it properly. We'll choose every tile together; that makes it ours more thoroughly than a fresh coat of paint.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It could take all our savings.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put the money under 'our roof', not 'money gone'. Then let's choose what we can do ourselves. We wanted to belong somewhere; we can start by knowing what holds it up.

reason: A's expert survey/budget categories absorb repair and financial setbacks into the original hope through shared decisions.
